title: zanthoxylum clava-herculis subsp. fruticosum
intro: Zanthoxylum clava-herculis subsp. fruticosum, commonly known as Hercules' club or Toothache tree, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of this plant include its use as an analgesic and anti-inflammatory agent, providing relief from toothaches, headaches, and other pain-related conditions. The therapeutic actions of Zanthoxylum clava-herculis subsp. fruticosum include its ability to stimulate the release of saliva, which helps to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
